Off-season endurance training for climbers with vast experience training endurance

This 6-week program is designed to improve base endurance for climbing specific movements. This is a good plan to complete during a base training season when you are not aiming to have a peak performance. 

You can add strength and power, fingerboard or conditioning sessions to this plan but do not add too many power endurance sessions as this will create too much fatigue.

Session 1: 
Warm up > Style Triad > 1 on 2 off
Warm up > Style Triad > 1on 1 off 


Session 2: 
Aero 4s > Continuity
